research_question: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE — Does mindful breathing reduce acute stress in college students?

criteria.rule: intervention involves mindful or paced breathing

candidates.title: Mindful breathing lowers exam stress in undergraduates: a randomized trial
candidates.abstract: We randomized 120 undergraduates to mindful breathing or waitlist and measured salivary cortisol and perceived stress before examinations. The breathing group showed lower acute stress.

candidates.title: Breathing exercises in older adults with chronic anxiety
candidates.abstract: A cohort study of breathing exercises in adults over 65 with chronic anxiety disorders.

candidates.title: Exam stress physiology in college students
candidates.abstract: We measured cortisol awakening response during exam weeks in 40 college students; no intervention was applied.
